failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Arizona State men's basketball team ranking Bobby Hurley highest ranked' (attempting to verify the 'highest ranked' phrasing). Hop 3 query: 'Dan Hurley 2012-13 Rhode Island Rams head coach Robert Matthew Hurley Bobby Hurley Arizona State men's basketball' (re-asking about facts already confirmed in hop 1). Both hop 2 and hop 3 retrieved largely the same documents as hop 1 (Bobby Hurley passage, 2012-13 Rhode Island Rams passage, multiple Rhode Island season passages). The hop 3 query ignored the summary guidance that the core claim was already verified and only the ranking phrase needed clarification.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 returned multiple Arizona Wildcats passages (2000-01, 2002-03, 2003-04, 2004-05, 2016-17 Arizona Wildcats teams, plus general Arizona Wildcats program info) that are about the University of Arizona, not Arizona State. The claim concerns Arizona State's team coached by Bobby Hurley. These Arizona (Wildcats) passages are clearly irrelevant to verifying a claim about Arizona State, yet they comprise roughly half of the hop 3 retrieval results.
